headline: NYM @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 5.02 at CIN 4.08, with a projected total of 9.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: NYM moved -0.11 runs while CIN moved +0.84, changing the projected margin by -0.95 runs. The projected total climbed +0.73, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -15.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Brady Singer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, JJ Bleday, Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Steer because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
